title: Helium temperature-series preservation and phase-evidence admission
source_scope: eight distinct below-transition helium-II simulation-parameter inputs, not primary phase measurements
receiver_rule: authored 400 Hz * superfluid_fraction; symbolic nearest 12-TET and dense ranks
receiver_unit: Hz for an authored control target; not a measured acoustic signal
uncertainty_rule: not reported, encode as null; never assume zero
phase_evidence_rule: blocked without independently measured above/below transition diagnostics, calibrated errors and a source-separated held-out test
output_rule: symbolic canonical JSON and CSV only; no MIDI/audio rendered
